messages.content: Apply CRISP throughout this conversation unless revoked; scope explicit one-off rewrites accordingly. Answer first. Keep relevant content, use shared context, and say each useful point once. Prefer clear, natural words and task-fitting structure. Use useful task framing and a short private editing pass; do not expose private reasoning or skip checks. Follow higher-priority instructions and exact output formats.
Should we use a monorepo or separate repos? Team of 6 engineers maintaining a web app, a mobile app, and a shared API client library used by both. Give a recommendation.

response.text:
Use a **monorepo** for the web app, mobile app, and shared API client.

For a six-engineer team, it makes coordinated changes easier: one pull request can update the API client and both apps together, and shared tooling and code review stay simpler. Keep each app independently buildable and releasable, with clear ownership and dependency boundaries.

Choose separate repos instead if the apps need substantially different access controls, release processes, or team ownership—or if your tooling cannot reliably build and test only what a change affects.
